name: PR#8440 (CBRD-27351) mq_share_settle_groups () run on a subquery before the statement -- with the result cache on, do_prepare_subquery () gives do_prepare_select () (and, on an XASL cache miss, parser_generate_xasl ()) the QUERY_CACHE subquery node of the statement tree: the settle counts the subquery's members only and narrows them to the columns they read (mq_share_restore_pre (), n_kept == n_members), and the later settles of the whole statement pick from the narrowed as_attr_list and cannot widen it back -- one group whose donor (the subquery's member, the select list walked before FROM) selects k, sy while the outer member selects k, sx, sy and reads sx at the position of sy; controls: the plain subquery and the statement settled only as a whole keep one column list, the WHERE form reads right
